A later sparse prepared-table update changed 20,963 GPU pixels with one 288 KB queue write and took 183, 239 and 400 us CPU in three isolated runs. The consumer-specific visual page captured 10k rows in 32.52 us median and added 1.44 MB logical three-page payload; a separate assembled Metal run measured 1.373 ms median with broad tails and no controlled frame-time delta. No device frame-budget or GPU-upload-allocation claim.
A2_render_extraction.scope: A committed W1 visual read-model page copies only IDs, positions and visual selectors into preallocated SoA columns; held Arc leases survive later ticks and capacity pressure sheds optional views. V1_bounded_frame_host.diagnostic_measurement: Apple M3 Max/Metal, 10k entities/1.5k moving, 640x360, two optimized processes of 600 completed frames: 602/602 committed ticks, zero full callback over 16.67 ms, zero dropped views/reports/timing faults, callback CPU p50/p95/max 0.708/1.151/4.385 and 0.661/2.409/11.846 ms including nonblocking completion polling. Worker-owned snapshots/packets, surface, loss/recreation, cooked content, live view/light and Chrome/iPhone execution remain open.

It stores supplied digest bytes only; no verified blob closure, authenticated predecessor, physical reserve, crash/process-kill proof or accepted-source API exists.

i2a_sqlite_blob_proof.scope: Test-only SQLite 4 MiB chunk storage verifies stored exact length, hash and chunk layout before complete-state publication; a root refuses missing/incomplete blobs. Partial-input retry, complete-hash reuse, final verification/reset exclusion and stale-writer rejection are tested across two connections. Arbitrary test bytes are not a semantic source closure, and production disk/WAL budget, old roots, authenticated lineage, crash recovery and accepted-source API remain open.

i2a_staged_lineage.scope: Two checked provisional registries reread and rehash their source-carried history files, compare permanent fields and immutable type versions without copied entry vectors, and reject deletion from a supplied predecessor. A local two-buffer 100,000-field cost/RSS probe passes; current admitted-root authentication, physical reservation and durable source admission remain open.

i2a_manifest_blob_bridge.scope: A small test-only canonical TreeManifest is written to bytes, verified as a complete SQLite blob, committed as root digest with outcome and recovered exactly after reopen. This fixture buffers the small manifest and does not check its referenced source file blob, authenticated prior lineage, physical budget, crash durability or general accepted-source closure.

i2a_manifest_chunk_writer.scope: A test-only bounded writer emits canonical 100,000-entry manifest bytes directly to four verified 4 MiB SQLite chunks. A smaller two-chunk fixture checks root/outcome and reopened stored digest. Local Rust 1.99.1 release cost/RSS is recorded, but referenced file closure, prior-root authority, physical disk/WAL reservation, process-kill recovery and production admission remain open.

i2a_direct_file_closure.scope: A test-only manifest root transaction checks every direct file entry against a completed SQLite blob hash and exact length. Missing or mismatched files refuse before root/outcome advancement, while matching retries recover the persisted outcome. No authenticated prior history, dependency closure, disk/WAL reservation, pins, process-kill recovery or production admission API exists.

i2a_small_blob_batch.scope: Test-only small immutable blobs stage in groups of at most 128 files and 1 MiB input bytes; input and stored hashes are checked before one SQLite transaction commits. Rollback, reuse, reopen and manifest-root closure pass. Local 1,000-file release helper timings are recorded, including a one-file storage tail; physical WAL peak, process-kill recovery and full source admission remain open.

i2a_stored_root_lineage.scope: Test-only recovery verifies the current root revision, exact canonical manifest bytes and one complete history blob, then compares source-carried fields and type versions under a generation precondition; a changed root loses final CAS. Corrupt chunk/layout/hash, wrong project and stale lineage refuse. A 100,000-entry local decode/root-read cost and RSS probe passes. Candidate staged-byte provenance, GC pins, physical reservation, kill recovery and production admission remain open.

i2a_staged_candidate_lineage.scope: A test-only validated one-scene candidate supplies history only after its staged file is reread and rehashed; a same-length post-validation mutation refuses. Complete-blob reuse verifies supplied bytes with one lazily sized reusable scratch buffer. Local 1,000-file new/batch/reuse helper timing and RSS are recorded. Full candidate file staging, GC pins, physical reservation, kill recovery and production admission remain open.

i2a_candidate_root_proof.scope: A test-only three-file validated candidate passes staged-byte verification, current-root lineage, complete file/manifest blobs and atomic root/outcome generation commit. A/B edit, drift/lineage/stale/token refusal, reopened retry and concurrent same-token winner pass; local edit-to-root timing/RSS is recorded. Configurable disk planning, actual-space-fault recovery, GC pins, process-kill recovery, game-schema breadth and production admission remain open.

i2a_sqlite_physical_growth.scope: A test-only candidate path batches staged files of at most 4 KiB through the bounded 128-file/1 MiB SQLite writer while preserving staged-byte hashes, root CAS and retry. Local release measurements compare logical main/WAL lengths for a 4 MiB blob, 1,000 tiny blobs, complete reuse and an unblocked truncate checkpoint; matched batched and individual tiny-file stores differ 26.8x in WAL length. This is not a worst-case physical admission reserve, allocated-block/free-space proof, blocked checkpoint, kill recovery or production API.

i2a_candidate_space_preflight.scope: A test-only prewrite candidate check charges each distinct missing file/manifest hash, current SQLite logical/main/WAL lengths, existing checkpoint debt and actual available volume space. Injected main/WAL/free-space limits refuse without a blob or root write; local 100,000-entry fresh/populated and one-file/large-store costs are recorded. The planning allowance is not a proven physical upper bound; per-write WAL guard, temporary recheck, reserve lock, process-kill recovery and production API remain open.

i2a_wal_backpressure.scope: A test-only guard checks WAL length before blob, batch, verification and root writes, with nonblocking PASSIVE/TRUNCATE attempts and bounded repeated PASSIVE work. A pinned-reader test proves blocked checkpoint defers a new blob before its header, matching retry/conflict and complete reuse remain available, and retry succeeds after drain. Per-transaction page-growth allowances are heuristic; the earlier hard-cap policy was superseded by configurable planning targets. Production concurrency, observed high-water and actual-space-fault recovery remain open.

i2a_chunk_kill_recovery.scope: A local two-process test kills a child after the first 4 MiB SQLite blob chunk commit and before complete-state publication. Reopen preserves the prior selected root, exposes one incomplete chunk, refuses its root publication, and permits full verified restage plus a new root across reopen. This does not test final-transaction kill, assembled source candidate recovery, power loss, GC pins or production acceptance.

i2a_root_transaction_kill.scope: A local child process is killed after root-generation and retry-outcome SQL writes but before SQLite commit. An independent reader and post-kill reopen see the old generation and no new outcome; the same request then commits both and survives reopen. This is one test-only open-transaction interruption, not a power-loss flush proof, full candidate recovery, physical reserve or production API.

i2a_game_candidate_root.scope: One five-file test candidate carries a game-owned descriptor, its immutable history, a game record with optional exact JSON bytes and a required local scene reference through validated staging and SQLite root/outcome publication. A/B caption edit, reopened exact game bytes, same-token retry and invalid-reference refusal pass. Local tiny edit-to-root timing is recorded; editor application, multi-schema/external dependency closure, GC pins, physical bound, cook/run consumer and production acceptance remain open.

i2a_root_read_pin.scope: A test-only current-root reader registers one durable revision pin in a short transaction before out-of-transaction manifest/history decode, retains it across root advance/reopen, and releases it after success or validation refusal.
